mapper.sql: id AS template_id, notification_code AS code, content::text AS content_json, enabled, version
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_template (id, notification_code, content, enabled) VALUES (#{templateId}, #{notificationCode}, CAST(#{contentJson} AS JSONB), FALSE)
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_template SET notification_code = #{notificationCode}, content = CAST(#{contentJson} AS JSONB), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{templateId} AND deleted = 0 AND version = #{expectedVersion}
